name: archmage
description: Archmage — a pure arcade roguelike. Thirteen elements, seventy-eight resonances, five shuffled tyrants, adaptive procedural music, and the Ledger of Legends global leaderboard. Version 1.2 — The Ledger of Legends.

scripts.build: next build && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('.next/static', '.next/standalone/.next/static', {recursive: true}); require('fs').cpSync('public', '.next/standalone/public', {recursive: true});"
